visual: Powder-pink nodding bottlebrushes · finely cut green foliage · airy upright stems
soilWarning: Do not allow soil to dry out
prune: Cut back in late winter; remove faded flower stems
cvs: hybrid; sometimes listed as Sanguisorba × hakusanensis 'Pink Brushes'
hardinessNote: RHS H7; hardy in the severest European continental climates
resilience: cold hardy · wet-soil tolerant · pollinator friendly
uses: prairie planting · pond margins · wildlife gardens · cut flowers
uncertain: RHS accepts the plant simply as Sanguisorba 'Pink Brushes'; specialist sources variously describe it as a hybrid involving Sanguisorba hakusanensis and as Sanguisorba × hakusanensis
RHS gives a broad maximum height of 1.5–2.5 m and spread of 0.1–0.5 m, while UK nursery sources consistently give about 90–120 cm tall; the practical UK nursery size was prioritised
The supplied photograph is consistent with the characteristic nodding pink bottlebrush flowers of 'Pink Brushes'
